senses.gloss: , מַשּׂוֹי, (מַסּוֹי) מַשְּׁאוֹי m.(b. h. burden, load.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:1:20">Y. Dem. II, 22ᵈ</cite> top <he>אין כל א״י עושה מ׳ וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="P01468"><he>עשוי</he></cite>) the whole of Palestine does not produce one load of raisins.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:1:20">Ib.</cite> [read:] <he>ואין כל א״י עושה מ׳ אחד של צימוקין אלא כן אמר לן אין מקום בא״י עושה מסוי וכ׳</he> does the whole of Palestine not produce &c.? But thus he said to us, no single place in Palestine produces &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 92a:6">Sabb. 92ᵃ</cite> <he>המוציא מ׳ למעלה וכ׳</he> he who transfers a load from one territory to another at a height from the ground of more than ten handbreadths.

<cite ref="Eruvin 22a:27">Erub. 22ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>אל פניו</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 7:10">Deut. VII, 10</cite>) <he>כאדם שנושא מ׳ על פניו וכ׳</he> like a man who carries a burden (hanging down) over his face, and is anxious to throw it off; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 846:3">Yalk. Deut. 846</cite> <he>כאדם שיש לו מ׳</he> (add: <he>על פניו</he>; Ms. O. Erub. l. c. <cite ref="M01863"><he>מַסְוֶה</he></cite>).

Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXVIII (ref. to Ezra IX, 6) לאדם שהיה … והמ׳ עליו like a man wading through a river, his feet sinking into the ground and a load on his head &c.; a. fr.—Pl. מַשּׂוֹאִין. Y. Dem. II, 22ᶜ הביא שלשה מ׳ וכ׳ if one brings three loads of provisions at a time, he is not yet considered a huckster (תגר).—Trnsf. care, interest.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:1:5">Y. Ber. III, beg. 5ᵈ</cite> <he>אין לו מי שישא מַשּׂוֹאוֹ</he> he has none to take from him his duty (of burying a dead relative).—Pl. as ab.

Num. R. s. 1, beg. משלח … שיהיו נושאים מַשׂוֹאֵיהֶם he sends important men … to attend to their (political) affairs; (Tanḥ. B’midb. 1 מַשָּׂאָם; ed. Bub. מַשּׂוֹאָן).—מ׳ פנים (v. נָשָׂא) respect of person, partiality.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:22">Ab. IV, 22</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 6:10:4">Y. Snh. VI, end, 23ᵈ</cite>, sq. <he>מ׳ פ׳ ומקח וכ׳</he> partiality and bribe-taking.
<cite ref="Yevamot 79a:11">Yeb. 79ᵃ</cite> <he>וכי מ׳ פ׳ יש בדבר</he> was there partiality shown in that case?; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 104b:15">Snh. 104ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
